easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2
